details.description:
Vadilal Quick Treat Paneer Kulcha is a delectable and easy-to-make North Indian delicacy that you can now savour from the comfort of your home. Made with the finest ingredients, it is a flavour-packed dish that can be paired with various accompaniments such as curries, dal or chutney. Equally satisfying when eaten plain as a snack or appetiser, it's a versatile treat that will please your taste buds any time of the day.
With its perfect blend of spices and paneer, Vadilal Quick Treat Paneer Kulcha is a must-try for all food lovers who enjoy the rich and authentic flavours of Indian cuisine.

details.description: Vadilal Quick Treat authentic Roti Chapati can easily be coined as the great Indian bread. It is the most common preparation of North India, also known as Phulka, which is cooked on the skillet and then put directly on a high flame, which makes it blow up like a balloon. These soft and fluffy rotis pair well with all Indian curries.
